However, the overall hotel rates are significantly higher than comparable properties in the region. the check-in process was frustratingly slow despite the hotel being half-empty. food options were limited, however the quality was excellent and prices were surprisingly reasonable. i was traveling for a quick business trip so i expected better value for the rate. consequently the staff went above and beyond to make the stay pleasant. furthermore the room amenities were incomplete and the mini fridge did not work properly.
The ROOM for improvement is HUGE because the PRICE was WAY too high for what you actually get.
So I finally checked into the suite and the modern design features were ABSOLUTELY stunning.

Ok so, the location of this Outset Collection by Hilton is honestly just perfect for what I needed. I was super tired from driving all day and really just wanted to crash somewhere close to the highway. But then I walked into the room and found some weird inconsistencies with the plumbing that made the whole stay a bit stressful. Anyway, the front desk fixed it right away, the facilities were clean but a bit pricey for what you get and the bed was surprisingly uncomfortable.

Given that the nightly rate was under $150 and the pool area was expansive, the facilities offer superior value compared to competitors in the region. Therefore, the pricing structure is logically sound for the amenities provided. Since the staff greeted us immediately upon arrival and resolved the keycard issue within minutes, the service is undeniably efficient and professional. Consequently, the guest experience is elevated by the attentive team members. Furthermore, although the lobby could be better in some areas regarding layout, the rooms were immaculate and the fitness center equipment was modern. Thus, the overall cleanliness and miscellaneous amenities meet high standards despite minor design flaws.

Having stayed at a Hampton Inn nearby last month, I was curious to see if the Outset Collection could really deliver something different. The lobby was spotless and smelled fresh, which felt like a decent value considering the rate we paid on the app. We walked up the hallway just to check the view before heading to our room for the night. Once inside, the smart TV and the plush bedding made the whole stay feel surprisingly comfortable and modern. The room layout was perfect for our group, the price was fair for what we got, and everything was tidy even if the housekeeping schedule was a bit inconsistent.

The breakfast spread here was honestly better than what I found at the Marriott down the street last month. The lobby and fitness center looked super modern and kept the whole vibe feeling fresh. They had some weird limited menu items one night but the food quality was still solid overall. Coffee was just okay and the price tag felt pretty average for the area. The stay was great all around even though the room rates were a bit steep.

the location could be better in some areas, honestly just feels a bit off compared to where i've stayed before. i was there just a few days ago for a quick trip but noticed some inconsistencies right away.

I was so excited to finally check in, but the lobby felt a bit underwhelming and rushed. The location is just perfect for grabbing coffee or hitting the city streets. My room was spotless from the moment I walked through the door. The bed was surprisingly uncomfortable and the lighting in the bathroom was harsh. I called down to the front desk and they were incredibly helpful immediately. I just mentioned that the mattress felt too firm and expected a quick fix. They brought over a new topper within twenty minutes and the room smelled fresh again. The breakfast buffet had some amazing pastries and hot options that were actually tasty. The whole vibe of the hotel is modern and the design features really pop out. I just realized I had left my charger in the room but they found it instantly. It was a bit pricey for what you get but the overall experience and the cool decor made it worth it. The staff really saved the day and turned a rough start into a great stay.
room was spotless. beds were comfy. wifi works. lights are okay. great spot. staff was nice.

the rooms felt overpriced for the dusty state they were in upon arrival. i had booked this place for a quick trip after a long work week. however the location was undeniably excellent since it sat right next to the main transit hub. furthermore the in-room smart tv and high-speed internet worked flawlessly throughout my stay. consequently the staff was incredibly helpful and solved my issue with the thermostat immediately. i was actually surprised by how quickly the front desk team responded to my late check-in request. the modern design features were nice but the carpet in the hallway still showed visible stains. therefore the overall room quality was quite comfortable and the bed was surprisingly soft. finally the bathroom amenities were spotless and smelled fresh right out of the package.

I stopped by the Outset Collection by Hilton just a few days ago while driving through the area. The coffee prices were honestly a bit steep for what you get, but the breakfast pastries were surprisingly fresh and delicious. After settling in, I noticed the room amenities felt a bit worn and could definitely use an update. So we ended up spending most of the evening exploring the local neighborhood instead of staying inside. Even with those small hiccups, I still left feeling pretty satisfied with the overall stay and would consider coming back.
Just got here and I am so excited. Service was just okay with some minor issues.

the check-in process was a bit messy and the front desk staff seemed confused, which was frustrating. but once the manager stepped in to sort it out, the room was spotless and the bed felt super comfy.

The bed was surprisingly comfortable and the room was spotless, even if the overall quality of the furnishings felt a bit cheap compared to other Hiltons I've stayed at. I just booked this place last week and honestly it felt like a mixed bag from the moment I walked through the door.
The modern rooms were incredibly comfortable but there are still some minor issues to address for improvement.

the room rate was surprisingly low for the spacious layout and the bed felt super comfy right away. breakfast food was tasty but the prices were a bit steep and the seating got crowded fast. staff were super friendly though they missed a small detail on the checkout.
The location is convenient for exploring the area.

honestly the coffee tasted weak, but the drink prices were super cheap. so the gym equipment was actually pretty clean and ready to use. after a week there the staff just kept going above and beyond for us. eventually the lobby layout felt a bit cramped but the lighting was nice.

The service was outstanding from the moment we arrived, so the staff made our short stay feel genuinely welcoming and efficient. However, the location is inconveniently situated far from the main attractions, consequently requiring a significant amount of driving time to reach local points of interest. Heads up, the room design is weird and the price is way too high. The bed was clean and comfy. The coffee was just okay.

The room featured sleek modern design elements that really stood out. Bedding was incredibly comfortable and the overall quality felt solid. Prices were reasonable for what you get though there are still some minor inconsistencies to work through.
While the nightly rate feels a bit steep compared to other Hilton properties, the room's sleek modern design and plush bedding make it a truly comfortable retreat.
the front desk staff were completely unhelpful and made me wait 45 minutes just to get my key. for the price i paid, the room was missing basic amenities like a coffee maker and had stale towels.

I walked in with high hopes for my stay at the Outset Collection by Hilton, but the experience quickly became a study in contradictions. The lobby design was sleek and modern, and the front desk staff were incredibly welcoming, though the hallway carpet looked a bit dusty. My bed was incredibly plush and comfortable after a long drive, yet the furniture felt flimsy and the lighting fixtures looked cheap. The smart TV wouldn't connect to my phone and the minimalist shower head had barely any pressure. So after packing my bags, I realized that while the concept is promising, the execution still has plenty of room for improvement.

We stumbled upon the Outset Collection while escaping the city heat, and unlike the generic chains we usually see, their eclectic menu options were surprisingly welcoming with some fantastic local flavors. The housekeeping standards were adequate, though we noticed the occasional inconsistency in how thoroughly the corners of the room had been dusted compared to other Hilton properties we have visited. The location felt perfectly situated for our needs, situated right in the middle of the action just like many downtown competitors in the area. Unfortunately, the service was a bit slow during our check-in, which stood in stark contrast to the seamless experience we usually receive at other Hilton brands. While the prices for the cocktails were a bit steep, the variety of drinks offered was quite broad, and the quality of the ingredients seemed standard for this type of establishment. Compared to the surrounding hotels, the location truly shined as being within walking distance to the best local attractions and nightlife spots. We had just arrived after a long drive, so we were eager to drop our bags and find a quiet corner to relax before exploring the area. In contrast to the noisy main streets nearby, the hotel's position felt secluded enough to offer a peaceful retreat while still being accessible to everything we wanted to do. My husband spent the afternoon just reading in the lobby, enjoying the comfortable seating arrangements that made us feel right at home. The breakfast buffet offered a fantastic array of options, from fresh pastries to hot entrees, and the quality of the food was genuinely impressive compared to similar offerings elsewhere. Although the coffee station was well-stocked with various blends, the style of the serving cups felt a bit generic, and the quality of the coffee itself was merely average at best. After settling in, we decided to head out for a quick dinner before returning to our room to unwind. The room amenities were top-notch, featuring a plush mattress and high-end toiletries that made our stay feel truly luxurious.
The rooms felt standard compared to the usual Hilton standards I'm used to. The nightly rates were surprisingly low for the space, yet there were minor inconsistencies with the bedding quality.
Why would you even stay here? The facilities are JUST OKAY. The staff is AMAZING though.

the drink selection feels a bit limited and pricey but honestly the carbonara was absolutely divine. loving the modern design features and the general vibe but the bed was surprisingly uncomfortable. just got back from a quick stay there a few days ago.

the breakfast pastries were surprisingly tasty but the coffee was bitter and honestly overpriced for what you get. we stopped by on a random tuesday after driving down from the city and just wanted a quiet place to crash. the bathroom had some weird issues with the shower but the bed itself was surprisingly comfortable and clean.
